## Summary

Describe the coordination, geometry, semantic, validation, or documentation change.

## Evidence

- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make validate`
- [ ] `make preflight`
- [ ] Generated artifacts were intentionally regenerated, or this change is source-only.

## Model impact

List affected `asset_id` values, IFC entities/systems/ports, drawings, and export formats.
Call out dimensional or topology changes explicitly.

## Screenshots or reports

Attach focused visual evidence when geometry or drawings changed. Do not use a screenshot
as the only proof of semantic correctness.
